entries.notes: Nominal capacitance and geometry unchanged; rating raised from 10 V. C1 is on VBUS; C2/C23/C24 are on 3.3 V. Existing IPC lands differ from manufacturer reflow recommendations; assembler process approval remains open.

entries.description: 4.7 uF X7R(Murata) ceramic capacitor, 0603 / 1608 metric, 16 V, +/-10%, D suffix 180 mm paper-tape reel
entries.lifecycle_evidence: Exact D suffix exists in manufacturer product record and reference sheet. An explicit lifecycle commitment and live distributor stock were not established.
entries.notes: Nominal capacitance and geometry unchanged; rating raised from 10 V. X7R(Murata) uses a temperature characteristic evaluated with half-rated DC bias, not the ordinary EIA X7R condition. Record exact-part effective capacitance at 3.3 V before final qualification. The compact schematic value omits the dielectric, which remains mandatory in this purchasing description.
